title: Stable conormal comparison at a prime for a concrete complete intersection presentation
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $n,m,t\in\mathbf N$, $P=k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ and $Q=k[y_1,\ldots,y_m]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Let $I\subseteq P$ be an ideal, $S=P/I$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], $\mathfrak q$ a prime of $S$, and $g\in S\setminus\mathfrak q$. Put $S_g=S[1/g]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Let $f:\{1,\ldots,t\}\to Q$, $J=(f_1,\ldots,f_t)$, assume $t\le m$, and let $e:Q/J\xrightarrow{\sim}S_g$ be a $k$-algebra isomorphism. Assume $\dim\operatorname{Spec}(S_g)=m-t$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Define the conormal $S$-module $I/I^2$ with the quotient scalar action, $N=(I/I^2)_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], and $R=S_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then there exists an $R$-linear isomorphism $N\oplus R^m\cong R^{t+n}$, where $R^a$ denotes the module of functions from a set of $a$ elements to $R$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC (lemma-lci), last paragraph of proof of (1) => (4), through the stable conormal equation from Lemma 00S6 (lemma-conormal-module-localize); successive localization made explicit. Source checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00SC and /tag/00S6 on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Compose the quotient presentation e with the localization-away lift into S_q. This map proves Q/J nontrivial. The homeomorphism of spectra induced by e and [lem-weil-pbc-homeomorphism-krull-dimension] transfer hdim to Q/J. Nat.sub_add_cancel htm makes the dimension identity additive.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-global-complete-intersection-local-regular-sequence] at every prime of Q containing J. List.map_ofFn identifies the sequence with the family of localized equations.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-regular-sequence-conormal-free] at each maximal ideal containing J. Mapping a relation whose sum is in J² to its localized ideal, its conormal basis detects every coefficient modulo the extended ideal. At maximal ideals not containing J the extended ideal is top. Ideal.mem_of_localization_maximal implies each coefficient belongs to J globally. Lift coefficients from Q/J to Q to obtain linear independence of the equation classes in J/J². Span induction gives their spanning property. Module.Basis.mk gives a global basis indexed by Fin t. The complete Lean proof is in the private helpers span_conormal_generators, conormal_sum, coefficients_mem_of_conormal_basis, coefficients_mem_of_locally_regular and basis_of_locally_regular.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-conormal-at-prime-base-change] to obtain N × S_q^m ≃ (S_q tensor_(Q/J) J.Cotangent) × S_q^n. Base change the basis from step 3 using LinearEquiv.baseChange and TensorProduct.piScalarRight. Compose with the comparison, and combine the two free factors by sumArrowLequivProdArrow and piCongrLeft along finSumFinEquiv.
